author: mmusich
body:
#### PR description:

This PR is a follow-up to https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52448

- remove 51 files not reached from any entry point (`W101`)
- drop 14 imports whose symbols are never used (`W102`)
- rename cfi files to match the object they define, split `hltESPMkFit_cfi` into one file per `ESProducer`, and accept `process.X` assignments in process-modifier files as defining X (`W103`)
- make the vector-hit CA helper lists private (`W104`)
- remove duplicate loads of `hltESPPixelCPEFastParamsPhase2_cfi` (`W105`)
- run `testHLTPhase2MenuCheck` with `--strict` so any new warning fails it

#### PR validation:

To be done by the bot.
